StaticPages.aboutBody: neop is a marketplace for tickets to the world's best live events — concerts, festivals, sports, and theatre. We work only with verified sellers, and every order is covered by our 100% guarantee.
StaticPages.partnersBody: We work with a global network of verified sellers, venues, and event organisers to bring reliable ticket inventory to fans everywhere. Interested in partnering with us? Get in touch at <email>contact@neop.events</email>.
StaticPages.helpBody: Looking for your tickets? They're sent to your confirmation email and land in your mobile wallet shortly after checkout. For anything else, our team is one email away at <email>contact@neop.events</email>.
StaticPages.faqA1: Yes. Every order is covered by neop's 100% guarantee — if an event is cancelled or your tickets don't arrive, you get a full refund.
StaticPages.faqQ2: How do I receive my tickets?
StaticPages.faqA2: Tickets are delivered to your mobile wallet shortly after checkout, ready to scan at the door.
StaticPages.faqQ3: Who do I contact for help?
StaticPages.faqA3: Email us any time at <email>contact@neop.events</email> — we're happy to help.
StaticPages.privacyBody: We collect only the information needed to process your bookings, keep your account secure, and improve neop. We never sell your personal data. Questions about your data? Write to <email>contact@neop.events</email>.
StaticPages.termsBody: By using neop you agree to book events in good faith and to provide accurate details at checkout. Ticket sales are final except where covered by our 100% guarantee. Questions? Email <email>contact@neop.events</email>.
StaticPages.cookiesBody: We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your language and currency, and understand how neop is used. You can manage cookies at any time in your browser settings.
StaticPages.sitemapIntro: A quick map of neop — jump straight to any section.
